oneLine: Godrej Industries sold a stake in Godrej Consumer for ₹450.12 Crore.

sources.title: Godrej Industries Sells 0.50% Stake In Godrej Consumer For ₹450.12 Crore

synopsis: Godrej Industries divested a 0.50% equity stake, comprising 51.15 lakh shares, in Godrej Consumer Products to family promoter members through a block deal on the open market. The transaction was valued at ₹450.12 crore, executed at a price of ₹880 per share on September 24, 2026. Following the share sale, Godrej Industries' direct holding in the FMCG firm stands reduced from 23.73% to 23.23%, while the overall promoter group shareholding remains unchanged as part of an internal asset realignment.
